newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Stork says installation margins improve.
newsitem.headline: Stork says installation margins improve.

text.p: Stork NV said a gradual improvement in margins on industrial installation work had contributed to a rise in operating profits at its industrial services business group.
The group's first-half 1996 operating profit rose to nine million guilders from three million in the first half of 1995.
Stork also said results of its SBU Engineering and Contracting unit had remained at a satisfactory level in the first half of 1996.
Stork has recently expanded its industrial services business by acquiring aircraft maintenance firm Fokker Aviation, formerly part of the now bankrupt Fokker aircraft manufacturing company.
Fokker Aviation was not included in Stork's first-half results but will be consolidated in the full-year 1996 results.
